title: Editor E1, slice 5: eight more data blocks join the contract
detail: Adopts linkCards, circles, team, reviews, faq, contact, business and topfriends into lib/entity-blocks/contract/ with reads 'live', each through the shared data-section component. check:blocks now holds 40 of 41. The last registry block, guestbook, waits on a one-line update to the completeness test in scripts/check-blocks.test.ts, which pins the registry as not fully adopted; that edit needs the owner's say. Left on PROG-E1: guestbook and the binding layer.

verify.note: Fails when an adopted block stops holding the contract.
